name: S.A.D
source:
S.A.D is a ~8 minutes long story inspired by DDLC (Doki Doki Litterature Club), Undertale and a little bit by Pokemon Mystery dungeon games. 

[Edited from [url=https://kuramaaa0.itch.io/sad]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《S.A.D》是一部时长约8分钟的故事，灵感来自《心跳文学部！》《传说之下》，也受到少许《宝可梦不可思议迷宫》系列的启发。

[编译自[url=https://kuramaaa0.itch.io/sad]itch.io[/url]]
